summary: Tested new Trip Plan (multi-lock chain race) feature. Backend endpoint /api/session/{mmsi}/trip-plan works perfectly (6/6 tests pass). Fixed CRITICAL frontend bug: TripPlanPanel was used but NEVER imported in Dashboard.jsx, causing 'ReferenceError: TripPlanPanel is not defined' that completely crashed the Dashboard for vessel_owner accounts. Added missing import. After fix, panel renders correctly with all testids and data, BUT it is only mounted inside the mobile-only race tab (md:hidden) - NOT in the desktop layout as specified in the task description.

ui_bugs.issue: TripPlanPanel is only rendered inside the mobile-only block `<div className="md:hidden">` (line ~1505) within the mobile race tab. There is NO desktop render after the Lock Timing card as the task description specifies. On desktop (>= md breakpoint) the panel is hidden via CSS, so vessel owners never see Trip Plan. bounding_box returns null while element is in DOM with `md:hidden` parent.

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: TripPlanPanel is not defined - component was used at line 1517 but never imported. Caused the entire Dashboard to crash (uncaught runtime error overlay) immediately after login for vessel_owner accounts.

passed_tests: GET /api/session/{mmsi}/trip-plan - 200, correct shape (session_mmsi, user_vessel=null, legs=[], summary.overall_status='no_user') when MMSI absent
Southbound sim @ RM 820 → first leg = lock_2 (RM 815.2), required keys present (lock_id, lock_name, lock_rm, user_eta_minutes, status, required_speed_mph)
Northbound sim @ RM 750 → first leg = lock_4 (RM 752.8)
REGRESSION: POST /api/user-vessel/simulation/{mmsi} and /stop still functional (simulation_enabled field)
FRONTEND (after fix): trip-plan-panel renders with 4 leg cards (lock_2, lock_3, lock_4, lock_5)
FRONTEND: Summary tiles render correctly - 'Locks Ahead 4', 'Total Dist. 109.5 mi', 'Final ETA 11h 54m', Heading '↓ SB'
FRONTEND: Status badges render: SPEED UP, CAN'T BEAT (CLEAR/NO DATA states not encountered with active data)
FRONTEND: trip-plan-leg-{lock_id} testids present for each leg
action_items: MAIN AGENT: Add a desktop render of <TripPlanPanel /> in Dashboard.jsx outside the `md:hidden` block - the task spec says it should appear after the Lock Timing card on desktop (around line 1402). Currently only mobile users see it (after the race tab).

critical_code_review_comments: BUG: Dashboard.jsx had silent missing import for TripPlanPanel - lint should be enabled to catch ReferenceErrors before commit
LAYOUT GAP: Task spec required desktop placement; only mobile placement exists. Single-source rendering means desktop users completely miss the feature

POSSIBLE LOGIC ISSUE: In trip_plan threat detection, simulated user vessel can appear as competitor against itself for downstream locks because vessel data is in active_vessels under same mmsi, but the skip on `mmsi == session_mmsi` should prevent this. Re-verify when 'Your Vessel' is identified as threat (seen in legs 2-4 with absurd 981.3 mph required speed).
Trip plan response correctly omits MongoDB _id and uses prepare_vessel_for_output - good

rca_of_critical_bug: TripPlanPanel referenced but not imported in Dashboard.jsx. Reproduction: login as vessel_owner (any account with userMmsi set) → Dashboard mounts → React tries to evaluate <TripPlanPanel /> JSX → ReferenceError → entire Dashboard component tree fails to render, showing CRA red overlay. Mitigation: added `import TripPlanPanel from "@/components/TripPlanPanel";` at line 36 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx.
